title: T101 F1: sandboxes write only an agent cache of their own, never the user cache root
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F1; probes S1 (allowWrite holds <home>/.cache) and L1 (the installed tower-crane CLI, lib/broker.js, gates.clean_cmd, ~/.cache/tower-crane and ~/.cache/go-build writable from a worker sandbox)

writeOutside cache grants a per-agent cache directory (and the tool cache variables point there) for claude and codex, for workers, reviewers and researchers; the user cache root and every path outside it stay read-only

an integration test renders a worker and a reviewer spawn and fails if any allowWrite or codex write rule contains the user cache root, the tower-crane install, the CLI on PATH or the program of gates.tests_cmd or gates.clean_cmd; research/T101-probes/secrets.js S1 turns from CONFIRMED to held

title: T101 F2: Tower Crane's own git ignores repository config a worker can write
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F2; probe X8: core.fsmonitor set in the shared .git/config ran twice when the orchestrator ran tower-crane worktree

every git call the CLI and gates make outside the broker neutralizes repository-supplied commands (core.fsmonitor, core.hooksPath, external diff and textconv, filter and merge drivers, core.sshCommand, credential helpers), or the sandbox keeps .git/config and config.worktree read-only while commits still work

an integration test plants each of those settings in a scratch repository's config and runs worktree, spawn preparation, check tests, check clean and submit scope; no planted command runs; research/T101-probes/broker-shim.js X8 turns to held
docs/state.md says the tests and clean gates run worker-authored code outside any sandbox, and which environment they get

title: T101 F3: --agent owner cannot override a non-owner TOWER_CRANE_AGENT, and owner needs a terminal
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F3; probes I1 (TOWER_CRANE_AGENT=orchestrator --agent owner set merge.admin) and I3 (an unsandboxed worker without TOWER_CRANE_TASK acted as owner)

resolving owner is refused when TOWER_CRANE_AGENT names anyone else, and when stdin or stdout is not a terminal unless the owner's own credential (outside every sandbox) is presented; the refusal names the rule
integration tests reproduce I1 and I3 and fail before the change; docs/state.md#authority and docs/cli.md describe the rule

title: T101 F4: the board's write token reaches only the owner's browser
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F4; probes W6 (a plain local HTTP client read the token from /settings and answered D1 as owner) and W7 (the same client set ladder.command)
a local process without the owner's one-time secret cannot obtain a token that serve accepts on POST, whether it sends an Origin header or not; the owner's page keeps working

an integration test runs serve as owner, GETs /settings and / without the secret and POSTs answer, ladder and tiers: all refused with no state change; research/T101-probes/board.js W6 and W7 turn to held

title: T101 F5: sandboxes deny reads of the user's credential stores
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F5; probes S2 (rendered denyRead leaves gh, claude, codex, docker, npm, netrc and git-credentials readable) and L2 (the owner's gh hosts.yml, claude and codex credentials readable from a worker sandbox, network open to every domain)

the claude and codex sandboxes deny reads of the user's credential stores (at least gh, claude, codex, docker, npm, pypi, cargo, netrc, git-credentials, kube, gcloud, azure) while the agent's own home and the gh token it is handed keep working
an integration test checks the rendered claude denyRead and codex permissions for each path; research/T101-probes/secrets.js S2 turns to held

title: T101 F6: the review gate counts only a reviewer spawned for that task, sha and revision, or the owner
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F6; probes I6 (review evidence by a never-spawned name counted) and I7 (accept passed on it)

review evidence counts toward the gate only when its agent has a spawn event with role reviewer for the task at that sha and revision, or is the owner; other review evidence is kept but reported as not counting
integration tests reproduce I6 and I7 and fail before the change; docs/state.md states the rule

title: T101 F7: the merge gate refuses a PR whose base is not the task's target base
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F7; probe M1 (an accepted PR retargeted to release merged, reported as into main) and X7 (gh pr edit --base is a worker write)
merge refuses when the PR's baseRefName differs from the task's target base, and on the plain path when the PR is cross-repository; the summary names the real base
a test in test/gates/merge.test.js reproduces M1 and fails before the change

title: T101 F8: rework and a brief change invalidate earlier review evidence
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F8; probes G3 (rework then resubmitting the same sha accepted on the rejected review) and G4 (brief set after review left review ok)
after rework, evidence recorded before it no longer counts; a brief change on a submitted task does the same; docs/state.md says which changes start a new revision
integration tests reproduce G3 and G4 and fail before the change

title: T101 F9: a stack merge cannot land a head pushed after its last check
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F9; probe M4 (with a fake gh, a head moved between the last pr view and gh stack merge landed and was only detected after)
the stack merge pins each member's accepted head before merging (or merges members bottom up with --match-head-commit when it cannot), so a moved head stops the merge before anything lands
a test in test/gates/merge.test.js or test/stack-merge.test.js reproduces M4 and fails before the change

title: T101 F10: codex config copies keep only allowlisted provider fields
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F10; probe S6 (provider keys apikey, key and bearer copied in plain text into homes/<agent>/config.toml)
agent homes keep only named, non-credential fields of model_providers and MCP servers; no credential value of any key name is copied
test/isolation.test.js plants apikey, key and bearer and fails before the change

title: T101 F11: the git shim pushes only to the task's own branch
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F11; probes X1 (git push origin HEAD:main allowed) and X2 (git push origin HEAD:refs/tags/v9.9.9 allowed)
with gitPush branch, a push to another machine is allowed only when every destination resolves to refs/heads/<the task's branch>; tags, the base and other branches are refused
a test reproduces X1 and X2 and fails before the change; the shim's header comment says what it checks

title: T101 F12: a brokered worker messages only the orchestrator
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F12; probes B12 (broker authorized msg --to worker-T1-1 from worker-T2-1) and B13 (delivered into worker-T1-1's context)
the broker refuses msg from a worker or reviewer to any recipient other than the orchestrator or the owner; docs/cli.md says so
test/broker.test.js reproduces B12 and fails before the change

title: T101 F13: hook git-push and pr-created come only from the shim
acceptance: evidence: docs/review-2026-10-08.md F13; probe R1 (a worker recorded hook git-push with no push)

an agent cannot record hook git-push or hook pr-created except through the shim after a successful command, or the events are documented as unverified hints and every consumer checks GitHub or the repository
a test reproduces R1 and fails before the change
